system.summary: Grit; 3 Blunt; Close (5 ft). Punch-Up: your Unarmed Strikes use this profile, and it doesn't take one of your weapon slots.

automation.note: Punch-Up: make your Unarmed Strikes with this (3 Blunt) instead of the basic Unarmed Strike (1 Blunt). It already counts as an Unarmed Strike and takes no weapon slot.
